events.title: The termination shock
events.text: It reaches the termination shock and enters the heliosheath.

events.title: Arrokoth
events.text: It flies 3 500 km from Arrokoth, an object of the Kuiper belt.

events.title: Past Jupiter
events.text: It passes Jupiter at about 10 million km, on its way to Saturn.

events.title: Huygens let go
events.text: The Huygens probe is released towards Titan, Saturn's largest moon.

events.title: Huygens lands on Titan
events.text: Huygens lands on Titan after a descent of 2 hours and 27 minutes, the first landing in the outer Solar System.

events.title: Back past Earth
events.text: It swings past Earth 960 km up, onto a two-year orbit of the Sun.

events.title: Past Earth a second time
events.text: A second pass of Earth, 303 km up, sends it on towards Jupiter.

events.title: Into orbit round Jupiter
events.text: It enters orbit round Jupiter on the day its probe dives into the planet's atmosphere.

events.title: Closest to Jupiter
events.text: It races past Jupiter at a range of 130 354 km.

events.title: Closest to Jupiter
events.text: It passes 42 500 km over Jupiter's cloud tops, three times closer than Pioneer 10.

events.title: Launch
events.text: Webb leaves Kourou, French Guiana, on an Ariane 5.

events.title: Apollo 8 leaves for the Moon
events.text: The first Saturn V to carry people sends Borman, Lovell and Anders to orbit the Moon.

events.title: Apollo 17, at night
events.text: The last crew to the Moon leaves after a delay of 2 hours 40 minutes: the first night launch of an Apollo.

events.title: The last Shuttle from 39B
events.text: Discovery launches at night on STS-116, the last Space Shuttle to leave from this pad.

events.title: A first pass of Eros
events.text: A burn that failed just before leaves it to fly past Eros, taking pictures, instead of going into orbit.

events.title: Through the coma of Wild 2
events.text: It makes its closest pass of comet Wild 2.

events.title: Back past Earth
events.text: It flies past Earth again for a gravity assist.

events.title: Launch
events.text: Deep Impact leaves Earth carrying an impactor for comet Tempel 1.

events.title: Earth and Moon flyby
events.text: It makes a close flyby of Earth and the Moon, one of three that aim it at comet Hartley 2.

events.title: Past Venus
events.text: It passes 34 773 km from Venus, the first spacecraft to fly past another planet.

events.title: The last signal
events.text: Its last signal reaches Earth. It is still in orbit round the Sun.

events.title: Europa and Io, on the way in
events.text: While the probe is still approaching, the orbiter passes Europa and then Io.

events.title: Into Jupiter’s air
events.text: It meets Jupiter’s atmosphere at 47.6 km per second, then sends data for 58 minutes on a parachute. JPL’s path for it ends at this minute.

events.title: Two become one
events.text: The shuttle Endeavour's robot arm captures Zarya and mates it to Unity: the first two modules are joined.
